notes: Every selector is scoped beneath body[data-view="testimony"].
The dynamic [hidden] rule preserves the existing All/Public/Private/Drafts filter behavior.
The other display:none declarations are narrow responsive shell/topbar compaction states at approved breakpoints.
Pointer-events:none is limited to the header staging layer (whose child actions restore pointer-events:auto) and the non-interactive local-status notice; all 30 page controls remain clickable.
No external icon URL, new asset, new package, broad reset, or cross-route selector was introduced.
